general_treatment: Reuse the item when it is clean and suitable for reuse.
If reusable is not practical, separate it for recycling where a suitable collection facility exists.
preparation: Remove obvious non-plastic components when practical.
Keep recyclable plastic reasonably clean and dry.
reuse_options: Reuse as a container if the item is suitable and hygienic.
Use for storage or other non-food purposes when appropriate.
avoid: Do not burn plastic waste in open areas.
Do not assume every type of plastic is accepted by every recycling facility.
special_notes: Recycling acceptance depends on local facilities and plastic type.
Composite or multilayer packaging may require different handling.

general_treatment: Separate clean and dry paper for recycling where available.
preparation: Remove obvious non-paper components when practical.
reuse_options: Reuse one-sided paper for notes or drafts when appropriate.
avoid: Avoid mixing heavily contaminated paper with clean recyclable paper.
special_notes: Actual recycling acceptance varies by local collection facility.

general_treatment: Flatten and separate clean cardboard for recycling where available.
preparation: Remove excessive tape or non-cardboard components when practical.
reuse_options: Reuse boxes for storage or packaging when they remain structurally suitable.
avoid: Avoid mixing heavily wet or contaminated cardboard with clean recyclable cardboard.
special_notes: Local recycling facilities may have specific requirements.

general_treatment: Separate glass for an appropriate glass collection or recycling facility when available.
reuse_options: Reuse intact containers when safe and hygienically appropriate.
avoid: Do not handle broken glass with bare hands.
Do not assume all glass-like materials are accepted as container glass.
special_notes: Local facilities may distinguish container glass from other types of glass.

general_treatment: Separate metal for recycling or collection where available.
reuse_options: Reuse suitable metal containers when safe.
avoid: Do not handle sharp metal edges without appropriate care.
special_notes: Different facilities may accept different metal types.

general_treatment: Do not automatically assume the item is non-recyclable.
Inspect whether the item contains recyclable, reusable, or hazardous components.
preparation: Separate identifiable recyclable materials when practical.
If the composition cannot be determined safely, follow the local residual-waste disposal system.
avoid: Do not burn mixed waste in open areas.
Do not handle unknown hazardous contents without appropriate precautions.
special_notes: The model's 'trash' class is heterogeneous and may contain visually different waste items.
Verify the material before giving a specific treatment recommendation.
